claim: Modeling strategies and feature engineering guided by both data science and domain-specific knowledge achieve robust predictive performance across different years in plant disease detection.
falsifier: Apply the same domain-guided modeling approach to a different plant disease or crop dataset and evaluate whether performance remains robust across multiple years.

conditions: Task: predicting ground truth counts of GRBD-infected grapevines
Domain knowledge incorporated via multi-agent system (Aleks) with domain scientist agent
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific plant disease (GRBD), grapevine dataset, regression model, and the two years tested; transfer to other diseases, crops, or model types is unestablished.
